name: Action
description: A collection of F-Curves for animation

props.name: Is Empty
props.description: False when there is any Layer, Slot, or legacy F-Curve

props.name: Is Legacy Action
props.description: Return whether this is a legacy Action. Legacy Actions have no layers or slots. Since Blender 4.4 actions are automatically updated to layered actions. This will only return true on empty actions

props.name: Is Layered Action
props.description: Return whether this is a layered Action. At this point all actions are layered through versioning and this function will always return true

props.name: Slots
props.description: The list of slots in this Action

props.name: Layers
props.description: The list of layers that make up this Action

props.name: Pose Markers
props.description: Markers specific to this action, for labeling poses

props.name: Manual Frame Range
props.description: Manually specify the intended playback frame range for the action (this range is used by some tools, but does not affect animation evaluation)

props.name: Cyclic Animation
props.description: The action is intended to be used as a cycle looping over its manually set playback frame range (enabling this does not automatically make it loop)

props.name: Start Frame
props.description: The start frame of the manually set intended playback range

props.name: End Frame
props.description: The end frame of the manually set intended playback range

props.name: Frame Range
props.description: The intended playback frame range of this action, using the manually set range if available, or the combined frame range of all F-Curves within this action if not (assigning sets the manual frame range)

props.name: Curve Frame Range
props.description: The combined frame range of all F-Curves within this action

funcs.description: Deselects all keys of the Action. The selection status of F-Curves is unchanged.

Ensure that an F-Curve exists, with the given data path and array index, for the given data-block. This action must already be assigned to the data-block. This function will also create the layer, keyframe strip, and action slot if necessary, and take care of assigning the action slot too

params.description: The data-block animated by this action, for which to ensure the F-Curve exists. This action must already be assigned to the data-block

params.name: Group Name
params.description: Name of the group for this F-Curve, if any. If the F-Curve already exists, this parameter is ignored

funcs.description: Flip the action around the X axis using a pose

params.description: The reference armature object to use when flipping
